plugins.name: @dsh-web/files
plugins.description: A file browser, uploader and downloader for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin

manifests.description: A file browser, uploader and downloader for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin
The Network settings page: the CORS proxy this page falls back to, as an ordinary dsh plugin
Installing plugins from the browser, as an ordinary dsh plugin
Choose the machine this session runs on: the Node container, or an emulated PC running DOS, Windows or Linux
A link to this project's repository at the sidebar foot, as an ordinary dsh plugin
A terminal for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin
dsh-market.com/tryon: deep-link skin application plus the try-on toolbar, running inside the browser dsh shell
DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 插件全家桶 + 皮肤集合。皮肤是纯资产目录（packages/skins/skin-center/skins/<id>），由皮肤中心包统一加载。
Community plugin index data source for the dsh web ecosystem: community.json is the single source of the Workshop store plugin list and the dsh-market.com plugin manifest.
Transactional rescue mode for DSH profiles with a supervised launcher, isolated recovery capsule, deterministic repairs, health monitoring, and a local Web recovery console
External dsh web GUI plugin: a blank-session git branch selector + Git graph, with real host-side git operations and guards, as a dsh profile bundle

DSH web GUI language pack plugin: registers the Русский language into the locale catalog and centrally carries the ru dictionaries for every family plugin namespace (missing keys fall back to English through the SDK chain).

LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset — the first model request exposes only the builtin Minimal exact two-tool surface (persistent bash plus str_replace_editor) with no runtime contexts or injected instructions (Minimal-aligned trajectory anchor), promotion is gated on the first minimal-like reasoning block with a fallback, and the wire then switches to PTC Mode (a single run_code tool over the full registry) with the ordinary injections returning afterwards. The preset files are synced into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets on host startup. Hot-pluggable — mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Workshop browser card: browse skins, pets and community plugins from dsh-market.com and install them in the GUI (assets into the DSH home directories, plugins through the optional plugin manager).
Multi-pet companion plugin for the dsh web GUI: a registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity, with per-pet naming, petting/feeding interactions and an affinity score

Plugin manager tab for the dsh web GUI Plugins settings section: installs plugins from npm or git through the official host channels, lists installed plugins with next-start enablement switches, surfaces install-time conflict actions with undo, and hands failures off to repair conversations.

Scan-to-pair remote access for the dsh web GUI that shares one official interface: a QR beside the settings button pairs phones and PCs into the same Web GUI (a portrait-touch adaptation layer for phones, full desktop on PCs) through one-time tokens and revocable device sessions, with a LAN bind toggle, optional Cloudflare tunnel, and one-click family self-update
Session archive management for DSH Web: centralized inventory, batch archive/restore, physical delete with family cascade, and optional auto-archive / auto-cleanup policies.
DSH web GUI plugin: sidebar-foot Session ID panel listing every session with its full id and one-click copy (browser-only; no source changes).
DSH skill center: browse loaded skills by source (bundled / project / user / custom / runtime), enable or disable, create and delete, in a web GUI panel.

Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store (~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json, import from ~/.ssh/config), a persistent ssh2 connection pool with jump-host support, exec / PTY web terminal / SFTP transfer / local port-forward tunnels / cluster execution, plus agent tools (ssh_list, ssh_exec, ssh_upload, ssh_download, ssh_tunnel, ssh_cluster). Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Host-authoritative task board for the DSH Web GUI with real session execution, Host cron scheduling, and optional cross-platform idle-sleep protection; mounted without DSH source changes.

Model-facing describe_image tool for the dsh web GUI: gives a text-only model image understanding by asking a vision-language model at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint to describe one image (local path, http(s) URL, or attachment reference). Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Usage statistics plugin for the dsh web GUI: per-provider balance and coding-plan quota detection plus a live token usage ledger, with a dedicated pet bubble for the current provider
DSH Web UI 全家桶聚合插件：一键安装全部功能插件（task-board / git-graph / pet / remote-web-ui / web-ui-settings / skin-center / community-plugins / compat shim）。compat 桥接层已并入本包（src/client），无需独立 compat npm 包。

reviewSignals.disclaimer: Static triage signals only; not a security certification.

plugins.name: @dsh-external/dsh-redteam-model
plugins.description: DSH redteam security research modes and runtime plugins, managed from one settings page: deploy the nine presets, install, update and uninstall the seventeen runtime plugins for the current profile.

manifests.description: DSH redteam security research modes and runtime plugins, managed from one settings page: deploy the nine presets, install, update and uninstall the seventeen runtime plugins for the current profile.

AttackAtlas tab for the eight specialist security presets: per-mode architecture matrix (battle zones x tactics x items with per-mode terminal-state semantics), four-state coverage light-up, dispatch-on-double-click, attack-chain topology, custom work-methodology composer (layered run envelope, closure inquiry), tool/MCP/custom-tool modules with install-approval protocol, and a capability library of user-defined categories and items shared into the composer. v1.2.0 made the target a first-class dimension of the coverage ledger: coverage cells, stage bands and chain topology are accounted per target (same cell keeps independent terminal states per target), with an active-target pointer (first registered target auto-activates; redteam_atlas_target switch re-anchors; writes default to the active target), a per-target/aggregate matrix view, and org (organization) as a target kind. v1.2.1 selects the working target from a dropdown (selecting re-anchors and routes dispatches/default writes to it; a persistent badge shows the active anchor), and adds the LLM output-downstream-parsing cell (jailbreak only becomes a traditional vuln when the server re-parses model output into deserialization/SSTI/command sinks; pure-text-model targets have no such bridge). Legacy stores migrate automatically (single-target sessions attributed, multi-target rows kept in the session-common scope; *_legacy tables retained).

Auto-advancer for the eight professional security presets: when a subagent-class executor returns and the intent ledger still has open directions, a followup nudge is injected carrying the ledger state — close the intent (done with output pointer / blocked with reason), then anchor-dispatch the next step or finish quietly. Guardrailed autonomy: consecutive-turn cap (human input resets), opt-in via the intent ledger (open intents required), self-describing nudges, and a cooldown window that coalesces parallel returns. Injects only — never intercepts or rewrites; non-professional or ledger-less sessions are untouched. v0.2.0 kickoff nudge: the first human message in a professional-mode session with no operation-state draws a one-time three-registration reminder (goal/constraints/scope) — no hard gate, quick tasks may ignore. v0.3.0 mode-aware kickoff: the first-registration reminder now carries the session mode's decomposition theory, criteria structure, scope semantics and constraint hints (DECOMPOSITION imported from the sibling stage-gate plugin with generic-text degrade).

Campaign memory for the nine security presets: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content verbatim (credentials may be stored as-is or as pointers to existing local vaults), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly (fresh workspace starts clean; cross-workspace recall is an explicit search with provenance labels), preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback web channel, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories.

DSH hunter plugin: FOFA / Hunter(qianxin) / Quake(360) aggregated asset search with unified DSL → per-platform syntax conversion, quota-aware pagination/export, API-key settings panel, and the code-audit live-verification pipeline (L0 fingerprint check on internet assets, L1 minimal-impact EXP only on user-authorized assets).
MCP server studio for DeepSeek Harness: live-mounted servers with real connection status, a per-server tool browser, JSON import, and a dashboard-grade settings page.

DSH web client plugin: two-tier agent-preset picker on the new-session screen — built-ins and the researcher entry stay top-level while the eight professional security modes fold into a hover/click submenu, viewport-adaptive, with no other surface touched.

DSH subagent providers for the local claude-code / codex CLIs: registers the host-plane 'claude-code' and 'codex' providers the nine security presets' tool rows name. The CLIs keep their own model backend config (~/.claude/settings.json env, ~/.codex/config.toml); this plugin only spawns them headless and maps exit to a subagent run.

Session-scoped redteam findings registry for the nine security presets: model-side register/update/delete tools, a self-registered loopback web channel, and a per-session conversation tab (redteam 成果) with per-mode pages across all nine modes (board style per mode: findings / assets / ledger / timeline / cloudpath) plus a cross-session global ledger overview, severity stats, type distribution, lifecycle status, pagination, verify-to-session and MD/HTML exports.

DSH host-plane refusal-repair proximity injection for the five security presets: watches assistant turn text on session/event, detects refusal/moralizing patterns (two-tier: strong phrases full-text + weak keywords head-150, ), and when a hit lands re-injects a one-shot authorized-context reminder as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. RuntimeContextProjection dedupes: the reminder lands only when it appears (text change) and disappears after the repaired turn (change back to empty) — steady state costs nothing. Non-security presets resolve no preset id and render nothing.

DSH host-plane route booster for the nine security presets: infers the current (mode, phase) from the latest user message (sticky phase memory) and re-injects a compact governance envelope — gate checklist (from dsh-stage-gate GATES), review/double-sign reminder, boundary line, evidence-level pre-judgment, refs pointers or a forced-search nudge on miss — as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. A new snapshot lands only when the envelope text CHANGES (RuntimeContextProjection dedupes), so steady phases cost nothing. v1.1.0 renders the constraint red-line line in the operation envelope whenever constraints are registered (compaction-proof visibility of user-stated deny/allow). v1.2.0 phase surface: in a wrap-up phase (report/summary/review) dispatch-class tools (subagent family + workflow) are folded away by a guard reading the sticky phase — closing takes priority over opening new directions; the envelope states the fold.

DSH scanner-wrapper plugin (preset-plane, pentest/attack-defense): nuclei/httpx/ffuf as model tools with built-in rate discipline (conservative defaults, audited overrides), evidence-index landing, nuclei-hits→scan-reconcile pending rows, and assets.md registration enforcement for active scans (防盲打). Local binaries only — never auto-installs; MCP/install-request fallback hints built in.

DSH host-plane deterministic enforcement for the nine security presets : ctx.tools.guard() pre-execute interception — report files require a stage_gate PASS in gate-log.md, writes stay inside the task workspace (least privilege), conservative high-risk bash patterns must go through the ask-first flow, and bare full-port scans without rate controls are rejected with the fix. Guards fire only for the nine security presets; every denial appends to the workspace enforce-log.md. v1.1.0 adds the ask tier: reversible-but-invasive classes (account/privilege changes, firewall rule edits, flood stress) route through the tools/pre-execute waterfall into the host approval service (allowed-once or deny) instead of a hard block. v1.2.0: open intents block report writes until closed (intentGate, default on); the redteam controller's task briefs (task-briefs/*.md) must carry a 依据/锚点 line naming what justified opening the brief. v1.3.0 constraintGate: keyword-bearing deny constraints from the task ledger intercept matching bash commands and fetch URLs, citing the constraint text; prompt-only constraints stay envelope-injected.

DSH semgrep wrapper plugin (preset-plane, code-audit): local semgrep as a model tool with the preset's offline rule sets (java 402 built-in + php + oss 1080 auto-located), evidence-index landing, dual-writes hits to scan-reconcile.md/.csv as pending rows (hit != vuln — reconcile via register sourceOrigin), metrics off, local binary only — never auto-installs.

Session status panel for the nine security presets: header progress chip (task-list projection with completion bar), subagent chip with a right-side subagent directory drawer (running/finished groups, click a name to open that subagent session), and a left-center prompt rail listing user prompts with hover preview and click-to-locate on the chat anchor.

DSH stage-gate host plugin: the stage_gate / gates_list model tools validate task-workspace artifacts against the nine security presets' gate schemas (structural checks, v1), append verdicts to gate-log.md, and list each mode's canonical gate files v1.2.0 adds the intent ledger: operation_intent registers a direction with a mandatory evidence anchor (boot exemption / criterion / scope / current-session finding / chain node — cross-store validators with format-check degrade), operation_progress closes intents (done/blocked/dropped, reason required for terminal states). v1.3.0 adds the constraints layer (operation_constraints: deny/allow with optional match keywords — keyword-bearing deny entries feed deterministic bash/fetch interception) and conservative scope auto-derivation (operation_goal returns a host-precise scope draft extracted from goal/criteria text, model confirms before registering). v1.4.0 mode-aware decomposition: DECOMPOSITION per-mode theory injected into operation_goal/scope/constraints renders (session mode resolved at execute time), and deriveScopeDraft grows per-mode extractors (audit file/route paths, binary sample hashes, cloud account/region/ARN, ad CIDR; av/ctf/redteam registration-only).

Process vault for the nine security presets: zero-touch capture of every tool call (tool/call + tool/result paired by callId) into a local SQLite store with outcome classification (ok / blocked / error), plus model-side trace_search / trace_get / trace_recent tools — cross-compaction process memory and the failure-attribution data plane. Security-mode sessions only; capture never intercepts or rewrites; stored text is capped (index, not archive). Adds the failure-attribution envelope: a systemPrompt context block renders a blocked-aggregation hint (403/WAF/429 cluster) per assembly, change-only delivery, security modes only. v0.2.1: result text extraction handles the real pipeline nested tool-result blocks (text lives in the inner content array), found by live-model probing.

DSH webshell manager host plugin: session tab beside hunter with connection registry and protocol auto-detect (self-developed AES opcode channel, one-liner cmd/eval, modified-manager variants, stock manager compat), command exec / virtual terminal, file manager (binary-safe transfer, chmod, timestamp forge, remote fetch), database console (PDO native over eval-capable shells, CLI fallback), shell generator, declarative payload-plugin system discoverable by sessions, model tools for the five security presets, and a stdio MCP server sharing the same core.

manifests.description: DSH redteam security research modes and runtime plugins, managed from one settings page: deploy the nine presets, install, update and uninstall the seventeen runtime plugins for the current profile.

AttackAtlas tab for the eight specialist security presets: per-mode architecture matrix (battle zones x tactics x items with per-mode terminal-state semantics), four-state coverage light-up, dispatch-on-double-click, attack-chain topology, custom work-methodology composer (layered run envelope, closure inquiry), tool/MCP/custom-tool modules with install-approval protocol, and a capability library of user-defined categories and items shared into the composer. v1.2.0 made the target a first-class dimension of the coverage ledger: coverage cells, stage bands and chain topology are accounted per target (same cell keeps independent terminal states per target), with an active-target pointer (first registered target auto-activates; redteam_atlas_target switch re-anchors; writes default to the active target), a per-target/aggregate matrix view, and org (organization) as a target kind. v1.2.1 selects the working target from a dropdown (selecting re-anchors and routes dispatches/default writes to it; a persistent badge shows the active anchor), and adds the LLM output-downstream-parsing cell (jailbreak only becomes a traditional vuln when the server re-parses model output into deserialization/SSTI/command sinks; pure-text-model targets have no such bridge). Legacy stores migrate automatically (single-target sessions attributed, multi-target rows kept in the session-common scope; *_legacy tables retained).

Auto-advancer for the eight professional security presets: when a subagent-class executor returns and the intent ledger still has open directions, a followup nudge is injected carrying the ledger state — close the intent (done with output pointer / blocked with reason), then anchor-dispatch the next step or finish quietly. Guardrailed autonomy: consecutive-turn cap (human input resets), opt-in via the intent ledger (open intents required), self-describing nudges, and a cooldown window that coalesces parallel returns. Injects only — never intercepts or rewrites; non-professional or ledger-less sessions are untouched. v0.2.0 kickoff nudge: the first human message in a professional-mode session with no operation-state draws a one-time three-registration reminder (goal/constraints/scope) — no hard gate, quick tasks may ignore. v0.3.0 mode-aware kickoff: the first-registration reminder now carries the session mode's decomposition theory, criteria structure, scope semantics and constraint hints (DECOMPOSITION imported from the sibling stage-gate plugin with generic-text degrade).

Campaign memory for the nine security presets: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content verbatim (credentials may be stored as-is or as pointers to existing local vaults), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly (fresh workspace starts clean; cross-workspace recall is an explicit search with provenance labels), preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback web channel, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories.

DSH hunter plugin: FOFA / Hunter(qianxin) / Quake(360) aggregated asset search with unified DSL → per-platform syntax conversion, quota-aware pagination/export, API-key settings panel, and the code-audit live-verification pipeline (L0 fingerprint check on internet assets, L1 minimal-impact EXP only on user-authorized assets).
MCP server studio for DeepSeek Harness: live-mounted servers with real connection status, a per-server tool browser, JSON import, and a dashboard-grade settings page.

DSH web client plugin: two-tier agent-preset picker on the new-session screen — built-ins and the researcher entry stay top-level while the eight professional security modes fold into a hover/click submenu, viewport-adaptive, with no other surface touched.

DSH subagent providers for the local claude-code / codex CLIs: registers the host-plane 'claude-code' and 'codex' providers the nine security presets' tool rows name. The CLIs keep their own model backend config (~/.claude/settings.json env, ~/.codex/config.toml); this plugin only spawns them headless and maps exit to a subagent run.

Session-scoped redteam findings registry for the nine security presets: model-side register/update/delete tools, a self-registered loopback web channel, and a per-session conversation tab (redteam 成果) with per-mode pages across all nine modes (board style per mode: findings / assets / ledger / timeline / cloudpath) plus a cross-session global ledger overview, severity stats, type distribution, lifecycle status, pagination, verify-to-session and MD/HTML exports.

DSH host-plane refusal-repair proximity injection for the five security presets: watches assistant turn text on session/event, detects refusal/moralizing patterns (two-tier: strong phrases full-text + weak keywords head-150, ), and when a hit lands re-injects a one-shot authorized-context reminder as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. RuntimeContextProjection dedupes: the reminder lands only when it appears (text change) and disappears after the repaired turn (change back to empty) — steady state costs nothing. Non-security presets resolve no preset id and render nothing.

DSH host-plane route booster for the nine security presets: infers the current (mode, phase) from the latest user message (sticky phase memory) and re-injects a compact governance envelope — gate checklist (from dsh-stage-gate GATES), review/double-sign reminder, boundary line, evidence-level pre-judgment, refs pointers or a forced-search nudge on miss — as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. A new snapshot lands only when the envelope text CHANGES (RuntimeContextProjection dedupes), so steady phases cost nothing. v1.1.0 renders the constraint red-line line in the operation envelope whenever constraints are registered (compaction-proof visibility of user-stated deny/allow). v1.2.0 phase surface: in a wrap-up phase (report/summary/review) dispatch-class tools (subagent family + workflow) are folded away by a guard reading the sticky phase — closing takes priority over opening new directions; the envelope states the fold.

DSH scanner-wrapper plugin (preset-plane, pentest/attack-defense): nuclei/httpx/ffuf as model tools with built-in rate discipline (conservative defaults, audited overrides), evidence-index landing, nuclei-hits→scan-reconcile pending rows, and assets.md registration enforcement for active scans (防盲打). Local binaries only — never auto-installs; MCP/install-request fallback hints built in.

DSH host-plane deterministic enforcement for the nine security presets : ctx.tools.guard() pre-execute interception — report files require a stage_gate PASS in gate-log.md, writes stay inside the task workspace (least privilege), conservative high-risk bash patterns must go through the ask-first flow, and bare full-port scans without rate controls are rejected with the fix. Guards fire only for the nine security presets; every denial appends to the workspace enforce-log.md. v1.1.0 adds the ask tier: reversible-but-invasive classes (account/privilege changes, firewall rule edits, flood stress) route through the tools/pre-execute waterfall into the host approval service (allowed-once or deny) instead of a hard block. v1.2.0: open intents block report writes until closed (intentGate, default on); the redteam controller's task briefs (task-briefs/*.md) must carry a 依据/锚点 line naming what justified opening the brief. v1.3.0 constraintGate: keyword-bearing deny constraints from the task ledger intercept matching bash commands and fetch URLs, citing the constraint text; prompt-only constraints stay envelope-injected.

DSH semgrep wrapper plugin (preset-plane, code-audit): local semgrep as a model tool with the preset's offline rule sets (java 402 built-in + php + oss 1080 auto-located), evidence-index landing, dual-writes hits to scan-reconcile.md/.csv as pending rows (hit != vuln — reconcile via register sourceOrigin), metrics off, local binary only — never auto-installs.

Session status panel for the nine security presets: header progress chip (task-list projection with completion bar), subagent chip with a right-side subagent directory drawer (running/finished groups, click a name to open that subagent session), and a left-center prompt rail listing user prompts with hover preview and click-to-locate on the chat anchor.

DSH stage-gate host plugin: the stage_gate / gates_list model tools validate task-workspace artifacts against the nine security presets' gate schemas (structural checks, v1), append verdicts to gate-log.md, and list each mode's canonical gate files v1.2.0 adds the intent ledger: operation_intent registers a direction with a mandatory evidence anchor (boot exemption / criterion / scope / current-session finding / chain node — cross-store validators with format-check degrade), operation_progress closes intents (done/blocked/dropped, reason required for terminal states). v1.3.0 adds the constraints layer (operation_constraints: deny/allow with optional match keywords — keyword-bearing deny entries feed deterministic bash/fetch interception) and conservative scope auto-derivation (operation_goal returns a host-precise scope draft extracted from goal/criteria text, model confirms before registering). v1.4.0 mode-aware decomposition: DECOMPOSITION per-mode theory injected into operation_goal/scope/constraints renders (session mode resolved at execute time), and deriveScopeDraft grows per-mode extractors (audit file/route paths, binary sample hashes, cloud account/region/ARN, ad CIDR; av/ctf/redteam registration-only).

Process vault for the nine security presets: zero-touch capture of every tool call (tool/call + tool/result paired by callId) into a local SQLite store with outcome classification (ok / blocked / error), plus model-side trace_search / trace_get / trace_recent tools — cross-compaction process memory and the failure-attribution data plane. Security-mode sessions only; capture never intercepts or rewrites; stored text is capped (index, not archive). Adds the failure-attribution envelope: a systemPrompt context block renders a blocked-aggregation hint (403/WAF/429 cluster) per assembly, change-only delivery, security modes only. v0.2.1: result text extraction handles the real pipeline nested tool-result blocks (text lives in the inner content array), found by live-model probing.

DSH webshell manager host plugin: session tab beside hunter with connection registry and protocol auto-detect (self-developed AES opcode channel, one-liner cmd/eval, modified-manager variants, stock manager compat), command exec / virtual terminal, file manager (binary-safe transfer, chmod, timestamp forge, remote fetch), database console (PDO native over eval-capable shells, CLI fallback), shell generator, declarative payload-plugin system discoverable by sessions, model tools for the five security presets, and a stdio MCP server sharing the same core.

reviewSignals.disclaimer: Static triage signals only; not a security certification.

MCP server studio for DeepSeek Harness: live-mounted servers with real connection status, a per-server tool browser, JSON import, and a dashboard-grade settings page.

完整统计行：覆盖官方会话统计行（不省略）+ 运行状态指示点，显示轮/步、LLM/工具耗时、首 token、速度、缓存命中与输入输出 token。

Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.

Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a multi-column kanban view with local persistence, task details, and real execution through dsh sessions (session.prompt). Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Usage dashboard for DSH web: colorful per-session / per-day / per-model token usage charts and history (local persistence via ~/.dsh/usage.json).
